A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] '''rebel''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team sent to investigate [[Gobindi]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon put the [[Planet/Legends|world]] under lockdown as it tested the [[influenza necrosi]] [[virus]], declaring the reason for the lockdown to be [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. The Empire discovered the Rebel agents' presence, and declared them to be wanted as pirates. The Rodian was found and arrested on Gobindi, after which he was subjected to influenza necrosi in a test room. He was consumed by the virus, rendered into a [[blob]].
